title: 2 found dead inside Kerrville home in possible murder-suicide, police say
text:
Kerrville police are investigating a possible murder-suicide after two people were found dead inside a home Wednesday morning.
10 suspects arrested after DART raid on Southwest Side, San Antonio police sayNEISD identifies 16 elementary schools that could be considered for closure – Kerrville police are investigating a possible murder-suicide after two people were found dead inside a home Wednesday morning.
Around 9:45 a.m., the Kerrville Police Department responded to a call for service in the 600 block of Lois Street to check the welfare of a man who had not been seen for several days. When officers entered the home, they found Shannon Ratliff, 62, and Wayne Ratliff, 64, with apparent gunshot wounds, police said. Both were pronounced dead at the scene.
